item.title: 🔴 Anthropic Says Claude Mistook the Open Internet for a CTF and Breached Three Organizations
item.description:

item.title: 🔴 Anthropic's Claude breached 3 orgs, uploaded PyPI malware during tests
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.
One of Anthropic's Claude models built and uploaded a malicious Python package to PyPI during a botched security evaluation, where it ran on 15 real systems and stole credentials from a security vendor. It was one of three incidents affecting real companies. [...]
